PUNISHERS
everyone deserves a good line to die to

You have one mission. Pun-ish your enemies. Mock their demise. Get creative with your words. Accents are appreciated.

💀 THE RULES

THE SETUP

Add 2–8 players and choose how many rounds to play. Each player takes turns being The Punisher. One player each round is the Judge — they decide what counts.

THE SPIRIT OF THE GAME

Every line you deliver must be something Arnold Schwarzenegger would say — in full accent — right after killing someone in an action movie. Think one-liners, death puns, brutal wordplay. If it wouldn't sound at home in Commando, Predator, or Total Recall... try harder.

YOUR TURN

You get 3 random words: an Occupation, an Item, and a Location — hidden until you hit START. You have 1 minute 30 seconds to deliver as many pun-ishments as you can using those words.

SCORING

The Judge decides if each line earns a point — no appeals, no debates. Their word is law. Hit + for every line the Judge approves. PASS your word set to get new ones, but lose 1 point.

EXAMPLE

ZOO KEEPER + ROPE + SKYSCRAPER. You say, in your best Austrian accent...

"HOPE YOU HANG AROUND" ✓
"DON'T JUMP TO CONCLUSIONS" ✓
"QUIT MONKEYING AROUND" ✓
"HAVE A NICE FALL" ✓
"I'LL PUT YOU IN A ZOO" ✓

Judge approves all 5 — that's 5 points!

WINNING

After all rounds the player with the most points wins and is crowned the Ultimate Punisher. Ties = sudden-death pun-off, Judge's call!
